title: Junior AI Engineer
description:
Junior AI Engineer
 About Maigrate 
 Maigrate builds AI-powered products for mid-market companies. We build lasting software, not one-time deliverables. We're early-stage, growing fast, and assembling the team that will define what AI-native software looks like for this market. The people who join now won't just build the product, they'll help shape how we operate and what we become.
 About the Role 
 We don't build in a vacuum - we get deep into how our customers work, understand what's actually slowing them down, and build what actually moves the needle. Junior engineers who join now won't just execute tasks - they'll learn by doing, work directly alongside senior engineers and AI strategists, and grow fast in an environment that rewards curiosity and initiative.
 If you're hungry to build real things and go deep on AI, we want to hear from you.
 * This is an in-person role based out of our Lawrence, NY office. 
 What you'll do 
 Build and ship features across the stack, from UI to backend, on real products used by real customers

 Work alongside senior engineers on AI-powered systems and integrations

 Learn how to make smart tradeoffs and take ownership of your work end-to-end

 Grow quickly by tackling a wide range of problems across the stack in a startup environment

 Collaborate with strategists and work directly with customers to understand their needs and deliver real impact

 What we're looking for 
 1-2 years of professional or internship experience in tech or a related field - recent grads welcome

 Genuine excitement about AI - you use it, you think about it, and you want to build with it

 A growth mindset - you ask questions, learn fast, and aren't afraid to be a beginner

 Startup energy - flexible, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out as you go

 Authorized to work in the US; able to work EST hours

 Preferred 
 Experience at a startup or fast-moving team

 You've taken a project from idea to working product, whether through code, AI tools, or a combination, and you can show it

 Experience working directly with customers to develop custom tools or internal applications
